# اُعْتُوِرَا (uʕtuwirā) /uʕ.tu.wi.raː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
# اِعْتَوِرَا (iʕtawirā) /iʕ.ta.wi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِعْتَوَرَ (iʕtawara)
